name: Atelier Bò
tagline: Pandan bánh bò, baked in a New York apartment. Poke it and it'll bounce back.
bio: We bake bánh bò nướng, the Vietnamese pandan honeycomb cake: green, chewy and full of holes. We sell it at small pop-ups in our apartment, with Vietnamese coffee, tea and wine on the side, plus whatever we're testing that week. Our first pop-up sold every slice. The second one is coming, and pre-orders open soon...ish.
terms: Pre-orders are held until noon on the Friday before a pop-up. Unpaid orders go to the waitlist, no hard feelings.

experiences.name: Bánh bò pop-up
experiences.desc: An afternoon in our apartment: pre-ordered bánh bò to take home, Vietnamese coffee, tea and wine, and a taste of what we're testing. Even if the slices are spoken for, come over anyway.
includes: Pre-order your bánh bò, then pick it up at the pop-up
Tastes of new recipes in progress
experiences.setup: In our apartment near 27th and 6th. The exact address goes to guests who RSVP.

experiences.name: Bánh bò for your event
experiences.desc: Pandan bánh bò and a Vietnamese coffee bar for your office, launch or party. Tell us the date and how many people, and we'll send a quote.
includes: Vietnamese phin coffee, served by us
experiences.setup: A table and access to power for the coffee kettle.

past.title: Bánh bò (Pandan Honeycomb Cake) Pop Up
past.about: Bánh bò is a Vietnamese honeycomb-textured pandan cake with a bouncy, mochi-like texture. With Vietnamese coffee and tea on the side. Drop in, drop out, from 12 to 3pm, with slices held for anyone who pre-ordered.

past.title: Design your life: what's stopping you
past.about: A cozy evening for curious humans who are still a work in progress. Questions that keep us up til 2am, fresh tea, Asian snacks and bánh bò. The very first episode of our Apt Cafe Series.
